results.name: Plate Deadlift
instructions: Stand with a weight plate on the floor in front of you, feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at your hips, bend your knees and grip the plate by its sides.
Drive through your feet to stand tall, holding the plate in front of your thighs.
Lower it back down by hinging at your hips.
tips: Keep your back flat throughout.
Keep the plate close to your body.
results.description: Plate Deadlift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Quadriceps, Forearms.

results.name: Plate Deficit Lunge
instructions: Stand on a weight plate, holding another plate at your chest if you want extra load.
Step back off the plate into a reverse lunge.
Lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Drive through your front foot to return to the plate, then switch legs.
tips: The raised front foot increases the range of motion.
Keep your torso upright.
results.description: Plate Deficit Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Plate Forward Lunge
instructions: Hold a weight plate at your chest.
Step forward into a lunge.
Lower until both knees are at about 90 degrees.
Push off the front foot to return, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your front knee over your foot.
Take a long enough step that your front heel stays down.
results.description: Plate Forward Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Plate Good Morning Anterior
instructions: Hold a weight plate against your chest, feet hip-width apart.
With a soft knee bend, hinge forward from your hips with a flat back.
Lower until your torso is close to parallel to the floor.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
tips: Keep the plate tight to your chest.
Don't round your back.
results.description: Plate Good Morning Anterior is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes.

results.name: Plate Lateral Lunge
instructions: Hold a weight plate at your chest.
Take a wide step to the side.
Bend that knee and sit your hips back, keeping the other leg straight.
Push back to the centre, then switch sides.
tips: Keep both feet facing forward.
Keep your chest up.
results.description: Plate Lateral Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Adductors, Hamstrings.

results.name: Plate Overhead Walking Lunge
instructions: Press a weight plate overhead with both hands, arms locked out.
Step forward into a lunge.
Lower until both knees are at about 90 degrees.
Step through into the next lunge, keeping the plate overhead.
tips: Keep your ribs down and core braced.
Keep the plate directly over your head.
results.description: Plate Overhead Walking Lunge is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Core, Hamstrings.

results.name: Plate Single Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand on one leg, holding a weight plate in front of your thighs.
Hinge at your hips and extend your free leg straight back.
Lower the plate toward the floor with a flat back.
Return to standing, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your hips square.
Keep a soft bend in the standing knee.
results.description: Plate Single Leg Deadlift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Core.

results.name: Plate Single Leg Pinch Grip Deadlift
instructions: Stand on one leg, pinching a weight plate in the opposite hand.
Hinge at your hips and extend your free leg back.
Lower the plate toward the floor with a flat back.
Stand back up and repeat, then switch sides.
tips: A good balance and grip challenge; use a light plate.
Keep your hips level.
results.description: Plate Single Leg Pinch Grip Deadlift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms, Lower Back, Core.

results.name: Plate Squat Hold Biceps Curl
instructions: Squat down and hold the bottom position, gripping a weight plate in front of you with arms extended.
Keep your chest up and heels down.
Curl the plate up toward your chest.
Lower it with control and repeat while holding the squat.
tips: Don't let your chest drop as you curl.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
results.description: Plate Squat Hold Biceps Curl is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Forearms.

results.name: Plate Squat Hold Reach
instructions: Squat down and hold the bottom position with a weight plate at your chest.
Press the plate straight out in front of you.
Bring it back to your chest.
Repeat while holding the squat.
tips: Keep your heels down.
Brace your core as you reach.
results.description: Plate Squat Hold Reach is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Core.
